title: Supervise work routines and staff performance

performanceCriteria: 1.1 Confirm the roles and responsibilities of staff
1.2 Identify the skills of staff and match with tasks and duties
1.3 Communicate job requirements and information to staff
1.4 Implement workplace health and safety, and environmental policies and procedures
2.1 Develop staff work plans to establish tasks and timelines
2.2 Prioritise work activities within available timelines
2.3 Identify and incorporate training and learning opportunities into work activities
2.4 Clarify and maintain supervisory and reporting responsibilities
3.2 Seek assistance from team members to achieve allocated tasks
3.4 Use appropriate conflict management strategies to address disagreements
3.5 Support reporting lines and supervisory structures
4.2 Provide clear and constructive feedback to team members to support achievement of outcomes

assessmentConditions:
Assessment of the skills in this unit of competency must take place under the following conditions:
physical conditions:a workplace setting or an environment that accurately represents workplace conditions
resources, equipment and materials:computer hardware and software
specifications:workplace health and safety, environment and employment legislation, regulations and codes of practice relevant to supervising work routines and staff performance
relationships:team members.
Assessors of this unit must satisfy the requirements for assessors in applicable vocational education and training legislation, frameworks and/or standards.
performanceEvidence:
An individual demonstrating competency must satisfy all of the elements and performance criteria in this unit.

There must be evidence that the individual has supervised work routines and staff performance on at least two occasions and has:

• identified and matched staff skills to tasks and duties
• supervised and instructed staff to achieve work activities
• implemented workplace health and safety and environmental policies and procedures
• developed and communicated staff work plans
• identified and incorporated training and learning activities
• promoted and maintained effective relationships with team members
• monitored team member performance and provided feedback.
knowledgeEvidence:
An individual must be able to demonstrate the knowledge required to perform the tasks outlined in the elements and performance criteria of this unit. This includes knowledge of:

• leadership principles for maintaining the work team
• workplace organisational structure and responsibilities
• workplace requirements applicable to health and safety in the workplace for supervising work routines and staff performance
• environment and employment legislation, regulations and codes of practice relevant to supervising work routines and staff performance
• principles of time management
• workplace training requirements and processes
• techniques for building trust and relationships
• principles of teamwork and negotiation
• conflict management techniques
• performance appraisal policies and procedures.
